narrative:
Functional OPEX — marketing, sales, logistics and G&A — runs at ~25% of net sales. The driver-based plan replaces manual cost-center entries: marketing scales with brand sales targets, logistics with unit volumes from Step 2, G&A with headcount plans.

China go-to-market consolidation and the shift of retail media to performance channels are the two largest efficiency levers. Decommissioning BW E0P reporting and moving to a unified data platform reduces the manual reconciliation effort in Corporate Controlling.

signals.title: BP Process Overview — Manual Entry Hotspots
signals.excerpt: Every step of the business planning process involves manual data entry or adjustments in SAC and Excel. Actuals are re-keyed from BW E0P; volume and price assumptions are emailed between controllers.

signals.title: F&C Workshop Munich — UDP Evaluation
signals.excerpt: ~30 F&C stakeholders reviewed ACDOCA access, real-time P&L, Material Ledger and Cortex Analyst. Priority: replace BW E0P, keep SAC as planning frontend, single source for actuals.
